query: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) FROM atom), (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) FROM bond), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom WHERE molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM molecule))
result: 444 distinct molecule ids in atom, 444 in bond, 343 rows in molecule, 3222 atom rows belong to molecules absent from the molecule table; 101 molecules are unlabelled

query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM connected; SELECT bond_id, COUNT(*) FROM connected GROUP BY bond_id; SELECT COUNT(*) FROM connected c JOIN connected d ON c.atom_id=d.atom_id2 AND c.atom_id2=d.atom_id AND c.bond_id=d.bond_id; SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bond_id) FROM connected
result: 24758 rows; every bond_id occurs exactly 2 times (12379 bonds); the mirrored self-join returns all 24758 rows, so the table is fully symmetric; connected covers all 12379 bond rows
validation_method: multiplicity and symmetry checks against the bond table

query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom WHERE substr(atom_id,1,5) <> molecule_id; SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom WHERE atom_id NOT LIKE 'TR___\_%' ESCAPE '\'
result: 0 mismatches out of 12333 atoms; every atom_id matches the pattern of a five-character molecule prefix, an underscore and an index

query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond WHERE substr(bond_id,1,5) <> molecule_id; and a decode check joining bond TR000_1_2 to connected on bond_id
result: 0 prefix mismatches out of 12379 bonds; bond TR000_1_2 maps to the connected atom pair (TR000_1, TR000_2), confirming that the two trailing numbers are the indices of the bonded atoms
validation_method: pattern check, prefix comparison and endpoint decode against connected

query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom WHERE atom_id LIKE 'TR%_19'; SELECT COUNT(*) FROM connected WHERE atom_id LIKE 'TR%_19'

query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) FROM bond b JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id WHERE c.atom_id = 'TR009_12'
result: 3 distinct bonds involve atom TR009_12, confirming that the atoms of a bond are reached through the connected table and that a single atom can participate in several bonds
validation_method: join between bond and connected resolved by bonded atom

query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom WHERE atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id FROM connected) AND atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id2 FROM connected); SELECT DISTINCT element FROM atom WHERE atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id FROM connected) AND atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id2 FROM connected)
result: 49 atoms appear in no connection; their element symbols are na, cl, h, zn and k
validation_method: set difference between the atom table and both endpoint columns of connected

query: SELECT MIN(c), MAX(c), ROUND(AVG(c),4) FROM (SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(*) c FROM atom GROUP BY molecule_id); and the same over bond
result: atoms per molecule range from 4 to 174 with mean 27.777; bonds per molecule range from 2 to 175 with mean 27.8806

query: SELECT ROUND(100.0*SUM(element='c')/COUNT(*),5) FROM atom WHERE molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type='='); SELECT ROUND(100.0*SUM(bond_type='=')/COUNT(*),5) FROM bond WHERE molecule_id='TR008'
result: carbon share among atoms of molecules containing a double bond = 38.69851 percent; double bond share within molecule TR008 = 3.84615 percent
validation_method: part-over-total ratio recomputed from the raw rows of the same reference set

query: SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(*) c FROM bond WHERE bond_type='=' GROUP BY molecule_id ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 3

query: SELECT DISTINCT b.molecule_id FROM bond b JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE b.bond_type='#' AND m.label='+'
